text: ともだちと　こうかん　した　おきにいりで　やっぱり　たたかう！

structure.jp: ともだちと　こうかん　した　おきにいりで
structure.en: with the favorite I traded with my friend for

structure.jp: やっぱり　たたかう！

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ともだちと　こうかん　した　おきにいり
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase placed right before a thing describes that thing. ともだちと　こうかん　した　おきにいり = 'the favorite I got trading with my friend'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing shows what you use to do something. おきにいりで　たたかう = 'battle using my favorite'.

patterns.name: 〜と (with)
patterns.explanation: と after a person shows who you do something together with. ともだちと = 'with my friend'.
